discrepancies.measuredResult: 12 approximation entries (vision:control-ward, 6 keystones, 5 secondary runes) had null playerDeviationNote and coverage conflated implementation, reference, and presentation evidence.
Darius bonus AD used approximate 0.85*(level-1) growth instead of exact League growthAtLevel(level); Vi, Ezreal, and runes subtracted level-1 AD constants without per-level base AD growth.
Darius R reset window (20s at ranks 1-2) never expired R back onto cooldown if unused, leaving R permanently ready after a rank 1-2 kill.

Vi Q dash was not interrupted by crowd control (stuns/roots) during flight, unlike Vi R which is explicitly unstoppable; Vi R also lacked knockaside damage on secondary enemy champions passed through.

Mountain Drake kill mutated armor/MR by 4% directly instead of dynamic 8% per stack (earthBonusDefenseFractionPerStack: 0.08), and Mountain Soul refreshed its shield every 5s even while actively taking/dealing combat damage.
Voidgrubs at 4+ stacks omitted Voidmite spawns on turret attacks, and Rift Herald lacked a summonable lane-siege mercenary option alongside direct siege charge.
